description: What one coin's chart shows right now, as facts: CHART PATTERNS (W bottom, inverse head and shoulders, falling wedge, fake breakdown, bull flag, range — broke out in the last 5 candles or still forming, with the breakout level, pattern low and breakout volume), the LAST 3 CANDLES' names (hammer, engulfing, doji, morning star, shooting star …) and the VOLUME bars (strong / normal / weak, green or red like the Asrai chart, quiet-then-big, buyers' share of 20 candles). Use for 'any pattern on X?', 'is that a hammer?', 'is the volume real?'. Every item carries Asrai's backtest mark — works / watching / no edge / opposite / untested — always quote it: only a falling wedge breakout on a big volume bar beat other coins; most patterns, every candle and volume alone did not, and a shooting star / bullish engulfing at a low worked backwards in crypto. Facts only: for entry, stop and targets use trade_plan; RSI divergence is in technical_analysis.

timeframe.description: Default: 1D (the only timeframe Asrai has backtested)
